title: Nearly 80 Bigfoot sightings reported in unlikely US state as hunters investigate

  • A team of Sasquatch hunters led by Mike Familant is actively investigating decades of reported Bigfoot sightings across New Jersey.
  • Key hotspots identified for reported Sasquatch activity include High Point State Park, Stokes State Forest, and the Delaware Water Gap.
  • The Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization has cataloged 79 total sightings in New Jersey, with the highest concentrations in Sussex, Burlington, and Ocean counties.
  • Investigators cited unusual audio evidence, including a 2022 vocalization recording that a military linguist determined did not match any known local animal.
  • Despite a lack of concrete physical evidence, a 2012 survey indicated that nearly 29 percent of Americans believe Bigfoot is real.
